dataList.name: Sangue Conservato
dataList.desc:
A fine turno, in base al numero di [KeptBlood] su di sé:
- A 5- Stack: ottiene 1 [Binding], 1 [Vulnerable] e 1 [AttackDown] nel turno successivo per ogni (6 - Stack)
- A 6+ Stack: ottiene 2 [AttackUp] e 2 [DefenseUp] nel turno successivo per ogni (Stack - 5)

dataList.name: Devo Mantenere il Sangue
dataList.desc:
Ottiene un nuovo pattern quando [KeptBlood] scende a 0 per la prima volta
Fissa la Velocità di questa unità a 10 quando usa l'Abilità 'Io... Sono... Il Principe... Della Parata...!'

dataList.name: La Frenesia del Principe
dataList.desc: Quando i PV di questa unità scendono al 30%, ottiene [BloodyCrave]

dataList.name: Falcione Rossosangue
dataList.desc:
Dà priorità al bersaglio con più (Potenza + Conteggio) [Laceration]
Sul Colpo, se il bersaglio ha [Laceration], recupera il 2% dei PV

dataList.name: Sanguivoro - Coagulazione
dataList.desc:
Mentre questa unità ha [Laceration]:
- Ottiene 1 [AttackUp] e 1 [DefenseUp] per ogni 5 [Laceration] (max 10)
- Ottiene 1 [ParryingResultUp] per ogni 10 [Laceration] (max 5)
- Subisce -50% danni da [Laceration] (arrotondato per difetto)

dataList.name: Blood Coagulation
dataList.desc:
Gain +1 [Laceration] Count every time this unit is hit
Turn End: consume 3 [Laceration] Count on self to gain 1 [HardenedBlood]

dataList.name: Thirst for Blood
dataList.desc:
Prioritizes targets with [Laceration]
Turn End: if this unit failed to deal any damage this turn, gain 2 [Vulnerable] and 2 [AttackUp] next turn

dataList.name: Bloodsucking
dataList.desc:
Damage taken from [Laceration] -10% (rounded down)
On Hit, if target has [Laceration], heal 10% of the damage dealt

dataList.name: Rough Bloodsucking
dataList.desc:
Damage taken from [Laceration] -20% (rounded down)
On Hit, if target has [Laceration], heal 15% of the damage dealt

dataList.name: Power Leakage
dataList.desc:
Every time this unit is hit, if the attacker used a Skill that gains [Charge], the attacker steals 1 [Charge] Count from this unit.
(Once per Skill. Does not activate if this unit does not have [Charge])

dataList.name: Blood to Brain
dataList.desc:
Damage taken from [Laceration] -30% (rounded down)
On Hit, if target has [Laceration], heal 15% of the damage dealt

dataList.name: Prosthesis Model - L37
dataList.desc:
Turn Start: At less than 5 [Charge] Count, gain 1 [Reduction]
Turn Start: At 5+ [Charge] Count, gain 2 [ParryingResultUp]

dataList.name: A Young Kindred
dataList.desc:
Damage taken from [Laceration] -30% (rounded down)
On Hit, if target has [Laceration], heal 25% of the damage dealt

dataList.name: Tenacious
dataList.desc: Self-inflicted damage due to this unit's Skills does not reduce this unit's PV under 1

dataList.name: Burst Bloodbag
dataList.desc: Combat Start: starts the Encounter only with half of max PV

dataList.name: The Seventh Kindred
dataList.desc: Gain +1 Slot for every ally at 1 PV (2 times max)
